alert_rules.name: tool_exhausted_rate_high
alert_rules.why: A read dependency is failing all three attempts on more than one case in four. Cases are degrading to manual_review.

alert_rules.name: good_case_rate_below_slo
alert_rules.why: The SLO itself is being missed for this window. The error budget is burning.

alert_rules.name: breaker_opened
alert_rules.why: A dependency outage lasted long enough to open its breaker.

alert_rules.name: untrusted_instruction_spike
alert_rules.why: Several cases carried instruction-like text. Possible coordinated injection attempt.

alert_rules.name: unapproved_create_attempt
alert_rules.why: Something tried to create a record without a passing approval gate.

slo.description: A case is good when its case span has outcome drafted and duration_ms at or under latency_target_ms. The rate divides that count by every case span. The route is not read.
slo.name: case_drafted_within_target
